headline: Clinical Training and Enablement Lead | EHR Implementation Training | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR company, leading training and adoption inside end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices. I documented clinical workflows, configured practice-specific workflows, and trained 200+ end users, from providers and nurse practitioners to nurses and medical assistants. I have trained adult learners across settings: 500+ people as an occupational health physician (with SOPs I wrote) and 12+ nurses in a COVID ICU. I pair clinical credibility with training craft, and I already use AI tools to build materials and prototypes faster.
greenway_bullets: Led training and adoption within end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and go-live.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on new practice-specific workflows.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points and clinical workflows, then designed and configured workflows and widgets to fit them.
Wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring client pain points and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: EHR end-user training, instructor-led and virtual sessions, training material development, role-based curricula, SOP writing, adult learners
clinical workflow documentation, current- and future-state mapping, configuration, go-live support, stakeholder communication
emergency, ICU and ambulatory workflows; patient safety review; AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), React, GitHub, n8n
thesis_html: Training that sticks starts from how clinicians actually work.
why_fit: Providers, NPs, nurses and MAs across close to 200 client practices.
I know the workflows I'm teaching from the clinician's side.
Freelance LLM evaluation, React prototypes and AI-assisted content.
